values.value: Active billing rule missing GL Treatment

Finds: Active blng__BillingRule__c records that aren't referenced by any blng__GLTreatment__c (via blng__GLRule__c). Why it matters: Revenue billed against this rule won't post to the general ledger. Month-end close shows unposted entries that finance has to chase down manually, and revenue recognition lags reality. Suppress a finding: when the rule is intentionally limited to non-GL billing (e.g. internal allocations). Disable the detector: only if your org doesn't post Billing to GL. Most should leave this on.
